索姆纳特位于索拉什特拉南岸，著名的湿婆圣所临海而立。神庙是与湿婆神圣显现“光明林伽”有关的重要朝圣地之一。沿海位置使圣所与印度西部的宗教和商业道路相连，吸引各地朝圣者及赞助者。

1026年，加兹尼的马哈茂德袭击神庙并掠走财富，这一事件被后世许多历史记载反复讲述。圣所后来重建，但1299年德里苏丹阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉的军队征服古吉拉特时再次劫掠神庙。此后数百年，尽管再有冲突及奥朗则布下令针对神庙，礼拜与重建仍继续进行。破坏、复兴和朝圣的漫长历史使索姆纳特成为阿拉伯海岸持续重要的宗教地点。

english: Somogyvár was a religious and political centre on a hill south of Lake Balaton. In 1091 King Ladislaus I founded a Benedictine monastery here dedicated to St Giles, bringing monks from Saint-Gilles in southern France. Its great basilica and richly carved stonework testified to the abbey's importance, and its first abbots came from France. In the sixteenth century the monastery was strengthened with ramparts and a tower against the Ottoman advance. It fell in 1543, and the buildings were burned during the fighting that followed, leaving the great abbey in ruins.
simp_chinese: 绍莫吉堡是巴拉顿湖南方山丘上的宗教与政治中心。1091年，拉斯洛一世国王在此建立献给圣埃吉迪乌斯的本笃会修院，从法国南部的圣吉尔请来修士。宏伟的圣殿和精美石雕见证了修院的重要地位，最初的院长也来自法国。十六世纪，为抵御奥斯曼推进，修院增筑土垒和塔楼。1543年，它落入奥斯曼手中，建筑在随后的战斗中被焚毁，宏大的修院沦为废墟。

english: Somuncurá is a great basalt plateau rising above the surrounding northern Patagonian steppe. Volcanic rocks, shallow basins and isolated hills give the upland its distinctive appearance, while springs and streams support life in an otherwise dry landscape. Its name is commonly explained as a Mapudungun expression referring to stone, and the plateau has long formed part of Indigenous Patagonian country.
simp_chinese: 索蒙库拉是一座广阔的玄武岩高原，耸立于北巴塔哥尼亚周围的草原之上。火山岩、浅盆地和孤立的山丘构成高地独特的面貌，泉水和溪流则在干燥的景观中滋养生命。其名称通常被解释为与石头有关的马普切语词，长期以来这片高原都是巴塔哥尼亚原住民地域的一部分。

english: Sơn La lies on a high plateau in the mountainous country between the Black and Mã rivers. Tai communities established mường in the valleys among the ridges, where cultivated fields contrast with the surrounding uplands. The Tai epic Quam tố mương recounts the movements of the leader Lạng Chượng from Mường Lò to Mường La, Mường Muổi and Mường Thanh, preserving a history of settlement and local rule in this northwestern country.
simp_chinese: 山萝位于沱江与马江之间多山地区的高原上。泰族社群在山岭间的谷地建立“勐”（mường），耕种的田野与周围高地形成鲜明对比。泰族史诗《Quam tố mương》记述首领浪章从芒劳出发，迁往芒罗、芒每和芒清的历程，保存了这片西北土地上居民定居与地方统治的记忆。

english: Sonaly is a steppe river of the Kulanotpes basin, in the uplands southeast of Lake Tengiz. Its waters belong to an inland drainage system whose streams reach a network of lakes and marshes rather than the ocean. The surrounding country is a dry, continental landscape of low hills and open plains, contrasting with the reed-fringed wetlands that gather in the Tengiz depression.
simp_chinese: 索纳雷是库拉诺特佩斯流域的一条草原河流，位于田吉兹湖东南方的高地。它属于内陆水系，溪流汇入湖泊与沼泽而非大洋。周围是低丘和开阔平原组成的干燥大陆性地带，与田吉兹洼地中芦苇环绕的湿地形成对比。

english:
Sonmiani lies on a broad bay at the southern end of the Las plain. Once a fishing village known as Miani, it became a port for the inland country of Baluchistan. Mudflats and the shifting channels of the bay made access from the sea dependent on the tide, while routes inland led towards the inland towns of Bela and Kalat.

Merchants used Sonmiani to exchange goods between the interior and ports of the western Indian Ocean. Henry Pottinger, who travelled through the region in 1810, noted the town's active trade and the part played in it by Hindu merchants. The port exported wool by the 1830s, adding a product of the inland pastoral country to the cargoes carried out through the bay.
simp_chinese:
索恩米亚尼位于拉斯平原南端的一处宽阔海湾旁。它原是名叫米亚尼的渔村，后来成为俾路支斯坦内陆地区的港口。湾内泥滩与变化的水道使船只进出依赖潮汐，内陆道路则通向贝拉与卡拉特。

商人通过索恩米亚尼，在内陆与印度洋西部港口之间交换货物。1810年途经此地的亨利·波廷杰记述了当地活跃的贸易，以及印度教商人在其中的作用。到1830年代，港口已出口羊毛，将内陆牧区的产品装船运出海湾。

english:
Sonargaon, 'the golden village', was a capital and trading centre of eastern Bengal, set among the rivers where the Brahmaputra, Meghna and Shitalakshya meet. Its weavers made some of the finest cotton cloth in the world, and its mosques, tombs and religious schools show the wealth of a city that drew travellers from far beyond the delta. Coins were struck here in the names of Bengal's rulers.

When Bahram Khan died in 1338, his armour-bearer Fakhruddin Mubarak Shah declared himself independent sultan of Sonargaon, built a trunk road and embankments, and conquered Chittagong in 1340. The Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta visited during his reign and found a prosperous place. After Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah united Bengal in 1352, Sonargaon stayed on as an eastern capital and mint. Ma Huan, who sailed with Zheng He, described a walled city of bazaars and a port. Under Alauddin Husain Shah it served as a base for campaigns against Assam, Tripura and Arakan, and in 1519 Mulla Hizabar Akbar Khan built the small, single-domed Goaldi Mosque.

In the late sixteenth century Isa Khan made Sonargaon the centre of resistance to the Mughals, and his river navy beat them in 1584. Ralph Fitch, visiting in 1586, praised the very fine cotton cloth made there. His son Musa Khan submitted to the Mughal governor Islam Khan in 1611, and Dhaka, the new provincial capital, drew away Sonargaon's political weight, though its weaving remained famous.
simp_chinese:
索纳尔冈意为“金色村庄”，是东孟加拉的都城和贸易中心，位于布拉马普特拉河、梅克纳河和希塔拉克沙河交汇的水网之中。这里的织工织出世界上最精细的棉布，清真寺、陵墓和宗教学校显示了一座吸引三角洲之外旅行者的城市的富足。造币厂在此以孟加拉统治者的名义铸造钱币。

1338年巴赫拉姆汗去世后，他的侍从法赫鲁丁·穆巴拉克·沙阿自立为索纳尔冈素丹，修建了干线公路和堤坝，并在1340年征服吉大港。摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰在他在位期间到访，见到一处繁荣之地。1352年沙姆斯丁·伊利亚斯·沙阿统一孟加拉后，索纳尔冈仍是东部的都城和铸币地。曾随郑和出海的马欢描述了一座有巴扎和港口的城墙之城。在阿拉丁·侯赛因·沙阿治下，它是进攻阿萨姆、特里普拉和阿拉干的基地，1519年毛拉希扎巴尔·阿克巴汗建成了单穹顶的小型戈尔迪清真寺。

16世纪后期，伊萨汗使索纳尔冈成为抵抗莫卧儿的中心，他的河上舰队在1584年击败莫卧儿军。1586年到访的拉尔夫·菲奇称赞这里织出的棉布极为精细。他的儿子穆萨汗于1611年向莫卧儿总督伊斯兰汗投降，新的省城达卡夺走了索纳尔冈的政治分量，但当地的纺织业仍然闻名。

english:
Soncino stands near the Oglio, on a rise above the Lombard plain. Control of the river crossing helped the town prosper after it became a free borough under Cremonese influence in 1118. Its walls and fortress grew during the thirteenth century, when the town also developed mills supplied by a network of watercourses.

Under the Visconti, Soncino became an important stronghold on the Oglio frontier between Milan and Venice. Venetian forces occupied it three times in the fifteenth century. Its woollen cloth found buyers throughout Europe. Alongside its military role, the town supported a flourishing trade in woollen cloth, carried on by local families and Jewish merchants. In the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries, Austrian and Napoleonic authorities dismantled parts of the town's fortifications.
simp_chinese:
松奇诺位于奥廖河附近，坐落在伦巴第平原上的一处高地。1118年，它在克雷莫纳势力范围内成为自由市镇，对河流渡口的控制帮助城镇繁荣起来。十三世纪，城墙和堡垒得到扩建，当地还利用水道网络发展磨坊。

维斯孔蒂家族统治下，松奇诺成为米兰与威尼斯之间奥廖河边界的重要据点。十五世纪，威尼斯军队三次占领此城。当地毛织品在欧洲各地都有买家。除了军事地位，城镇还拥有兴盛的毛织品贸易，由当地家族和犹太商人经营。十八世纪至十九世纪初，奥地利和拿破仑时期的当局拆除了部分防御工事。

english: Sonda lies in lower Sindh, near an extensive graveyard of carved stone tombs. Tradition attributes its foundation to the Samma ruler Jam Tamachi in the fourteenth century, and the settlement was associated with a respected family of religious teachers known as the Makhdums. The yellow sandstone graves bear floral and geometric designs, inscriptions and images such as mounted horsemen. Their carving preserves a distinctive tradition of funerary art in the Indus country.
simp_chinese: 松达位于下信德，附近是一片广阔墓地，墓冢以石雕装饰。传统认为萨马统治者贾姆·塔马奇于十四世纪创建此地，聚落与受人尊敬的宗教教师家族马克杜姆有关。黄色砂岩墓冢刻有花卉、几何图案、铭文及骑马人物等形象，保存了印度河地区独特的墓葬艺术传统。

english:
Sonda, also called Sode or Svadi, was the capital of a small kingdom in the forested hills of western Karnataka. Its rulers held territory reaching from the uplands towards the Arabian Sea. The town was fortified, and a Jain monastery stood here under the patronage of its chiefs. Their principality formed part of the political landscape left by Vijayanagara’s decline.

Arasappa founded the Svadi dynasty in the middle of the sixteenth century, and his successors extended their authority across the hills and coastal country. They fought neighbouring chiefs of Keladi and Bilgi and faced pressure from the Marathas and Bijapur. The rulers fortified their capital and obtained arms from Portuguese merchants. Sadashiva Raya II was also remembered as a writer; his surviving work Sadashiva Niti contains verses on a wide range of subjects. The dynasty’s rule ended in the eighteenth century as Mysore expanded into the western country.
simp_chinese:
松达又称索德或斯瓦迪，是卡纳塔克西部森林山地中一个小王国的首都。其统治者的领地从高地延伸至阿拉伯海方向。城镇有防御工事，境内的耆那教寺院也受到首领的资助。随着毗奢耶那伽罗衰落，这个小邦成为地区政治格局的一部分。

十六世纪中叶，阿拉萨帕建立斯瓦迪王朝，继承者将势力扩展至山地与海岸。他们与凯拉迪和比尔吉的邻近首领交战，也面临马拉塔人与比贾布尔的压力。统治者加固都城，并从葡萄牙商人处购买武器。萨达希瓦·拉亚二世还以著述闻名，其留存作品《萨达希瓦箴言》以诗句讨论诸多主题。十八世纪，随着迈索尔向西部扩张，王朝的统治走向终结。

english:
Søndeled lies at the inner end of a fjord near Norway's southern coast, where a valley and waterways meet the sea. Its medieval stone church was built between the twelfth and thirteenth centuries, giving the scattered farms of the district a shared place of worship. Farther out on the coast, Risør developed as a harbour for the timber trade with Dutch merchants.

The local congregation bought Søndeled Church at the church auction of 1723. A tower was added in 1752 and the building enlarged into a cross church in 1768, incorporating timber additions around the older stone walls. The same year as the church auction, Risør received full town privileges, reflecting the growing importance of timber and maritime trade along this part of the coast.
simp_chinese:
松讷勒位于挪威南岸附近峡湾的内端，山谷和水道在此与海洋相接。当地中世纪石教堂建于十二至十三世纪之间，为地区分散的农场提供共同礼拜之所。更外侧海岸的里瑟尔则发展为与荷兰商人进行木材贸易的港口。

1723年，当地信众在教堂拍卖中买下松讷勒教堂。1752年增建塔楼，1768年又在旧石墙周围增添木结构，将建筑扩展为十字形教堂。教堂拍卖的同一年，里瑟尔获得完整城市特权，反映了这一段海岸木材和海上贸易地位的增长。

english:
Sondershausen lies in the Thuringian country south of the Harz, where a princely residence developed beside a settlement serving the surrounding farmland. The castle and court gave the town administrative duties and supported craftsmen, servants and merchants. Agricultural estates supplied food and revenue, while regional roads connected the community with other centres of central Germany. Its urban identity was closely related to the presence of a ruling household.

A division of Schwarzburg lands in 1571 created a branch under Count Johann Günther, who made Sondershausen his residence. In 1697 Count Christian Wilhelm secured elevation of the dynasty to the rank of imperial princes. The residence developed in the Baroque era, and its court supported administrative and cultural life in this small Thuringian state.
simp_chinese:
松德斯豪森位于哈茨山以南的图林根地区，一处亲王驻地同为周围农田服务的聚落共同发展。城堡和宫廷赋予城镇行政职责，也支持工匠、仆役与商人。农业庄园提供食物及收入，地区道路把社群连接到德意志中部其他中心。城市身份同统治家族驻留密切相关，日常经济也受到宫廷需求影响。

1571年施瓦茨堡领地分割后，约翰·京特伯爵建立一个支系，以松德斯豪森为驻地。1697年，克里斯蒂安·威廉伯爵为家族取得帝国亲王地位。驻地在巴洛克时代发展，宫廷支持这个图林根小邦的行政和文化生活。

english:
Sóndor rises above Lake Pacucha near Andahuaylas in the southern Peruvian highlands. Its terraces, open plazas and stone enclosures occupy a hill overlooking the lake and surrounding valleys. The most imposing feature is Muyu Muyu, a hill shaped by concentric terraces and approached by a long flight of steps. The site was inhabited over a long period, including the eras associated with Wari, Chanka and Inca cultures.

During the Inca period, Sóndor was linked to the Qhapaq Ñan road network. Rectangular compounds and carefully worked stone masonry were added among the terraces, expressing the presence of imperial architecture in a place with an older local history. Excavations have also revealed evidence of domestic life and burials. The combination of buildings and prominent setting points to the ceremonial importance of this highland centre.
simp_chinese:
松多尔坐落在秘鲁南部高地安达韦拉斯附近的帕库查湖上方。梯台、开阔广场和石砌围屋占据山丘，俯瞰湖泊与周围河谷。最引人注目的是穆尤穆尤山丘，同心梯台塑造出层层台面，长阶通往山顶。这里长期有人居住，历经与瓦里、昌卡和印加文化有关的时期。

印加时期，松多尔与印加大道网络相连。长方形院落和精加工石砌建筑被增建在梯台之间，显示帝国建筑进入了一处拥有更古老地方历史的场所。发掘还发现了日常生活和墓葬的痕迹。建筑与醒目的地势共同表明，这座高地中心具有礼仪上的重要性。

sources.title: Proyecto Qhapaq Ñan - Rutas ancestrales del Qhapaq Ñan.pdf

english:
Sonepur, or Suvarnapura, stands where the Tel meets the Mahanadi in western Odisha. Its temples made it a celebrated sacred town: the poet Gangadhara Mishra described it in 1664 as a second Varanasi. Older copperplate grants already referred to its shrines under the Somavamshi rulers, and the temples later built under the Chauhans honoured Shiva, Vishnu and the goddess.

Sonepur came into the orbit of the Chauhan rulers of western Odisha, and in the seventeenth century became the seat of a separate kingdom under Madan Gopal Deva. Among its celebrated shrines is the Suvarnameru temple, beside the Tel near its confluence with the Mahanadi. Scholars differ over which seventeenth-century ruler built the surviving temple, but the worship of its deity is associated with the older sacred history of the town.
simp_chinese:
索内布尔又称苏伐那普尔，位于奥里萨西部泰尔河与默哈讷迪河的交汇处。众多寺庙使它成为著名圣城：诗人甘加达拉·弥什罗在1664年将其称为第二个瓦拉纳西。更早的铜版诰文已记载了索马王朝时期这里的神庙；后来乔汉统治者兴建的寺院则供奉湿婆、毗湿奴和女神。

索内布尔进入奥里萨西部乔汉统治者的势力范围，十七世纪在马丹·戈帕尔·德奥统治下成为独立王国的驻地。著名的苏伐那梅鲁寺位于泰尔河畔，靠近两河交汇处。学者对现存寺庙由哪位十七世纪统治者兴建意见不一，但其神祇的崇拜与这座城镇更早的圣地历史相联系。

english: Sonepur stands at the meeting of the Gandak and the Ganges, a sacred confluence visited by pilgrims who bathe in the rivers and worship at the Harihar Nath temple. Its great fair is held around the full moon of Kartik and has long brought animal traders and worshippers together. The fair was originally held across the river at Hajipur, while worship took place at Sonepur; during Aurangzeb's reign its market moved to Sonepur as well.
simp_chinese: 索内普尔位于甘达克河与恒河交汇处。朝圣者来到这一神圣河口沐浴，并在哈里哈尔纳特神庙礼拜。每逢迦提迦月圆前后，这里便举行盛大的集市，牲畜商人和朝拜者聚集于此。集市原先设在河对岸的哈吉布尔，只有祭祀在索内普尔举行；奥朗则布在位时，市集也迁到了索内普尔。

english: Sông Bé, the Bé River, rises in the southern highlands and winds through wooded country before joining the Đồng Nai. Its course bends repeatedly as it descends from uplands towards the southern plains. Narrow stretches, high banks and swift water distinguish much of the river, which gathers tributaries from a broad basin. The forests around its headwaters form part of the landscape between the highland plateaus and the lower Đồng Nai valley.
simp_chinese: 小河即贝河，发源于南部高地，蜿蜒穿过林地，最终汇入同奈河。河水从高原流向南方平原，沿途多次转弯。河道许多地段狭窄，两岸高耸，水流湍急，并汇集广大流域中的支流。源头周围的森林构成高原与同奈河下游平原之间的一部分景观。

english:
Song Khwae, later known as Phitsanulok, stands on the Nan River in the northern part of the central Thai plain. Its name means “two rivers”, recalling the waterways around the old settlement. The city was an important centre of the Sukhothai realm and later of Ayutthaya. Wat Phra Si Rattana Mahathat houses Phra Phuttha Chinnarat, one of the most revered Buddha images in Siam.

In the fifteenth century King Trailokanat of Ayutthaya moved his court to Phitsanulok during the struggle with Lan Na, residing there until his death in 1488. The city remained a seat for princes charged with governing the northern towns. Naresuan, later king of Ayutthaya, was born here in 1555 and returned to govern the city. Its place on the Nan linked the northern centres to the river routes leading south to Ayutthaya.
simp_chinese:
颂奎后来称为彭世洛，坐落在泰国中部平原北端的难河畔。其名意为“两条河”，令人想起旧城周围的水道。这里曾是素可泰王国的重要中心，后来也成为阿瑜陀耶的重镇。帕西拉达那玛哈泰寺供奉着钦那叻佛像，是暹罗最受尊崇的佛像之一。

十五世纪，阿瑜陀耶的波隆摩戴洛迦纳王在与兰纳争战期间将宫廷迁到彭世洛，直到1488年去世仍居于此。此后，负责统治北方诸城的王子仍在这里驻守。后来成为阿瑜陀耶国王的纳黎萱1555年出生于此，之后也回到彭世洛治理。难河使北方中心与南通阿瑜陀耶的水路相连。

english: Song Kul lies in a high basin of the inner Tian Shan, more than three thousand metres above sea level. The Song-Kul-Too and Moldo-Too ranges surround its fresh waters and broad, treeless meadows. In summer herders bring their flocks and horses to the lakeside pastures, setting up felt yurts on the open grassland. Long winters close the high passes and cover the lake with ice, giving this mountain basin a markedly seasonal rhythm.
simp_chinese: 松科尔湖位于天山内侧高盆地中，海拔超过三千米。松科尔套和莫尔多套山脉环绕淡水湖与广阔无树的草甸。夏季牧民将羊群和马群带到湖畔牧场，在开阔草地搭起毡房。漫长冬季封闭高山隘口，湖面结冰，使这片山间盆地具有鲜明的季节节律。

english:
The Songkhla Coast faces the Gulf of Thailand along the eastern side of the Malay Peninsula, where lagoons, fishing grounds, and cultivated land supported closely connected communities. Boats linked coastal settlements with markets around the gulf, while inland routes carried products across the peninsula. Rice, fish, and other local goods contributed to exchange. The region's position encouraged contact among Thai, Malay, Chinese, and other merchants and residents.

The fortified port of Singora flourished in the seventeenth century under Sultan Sulaiman Shah, before its destruction in 1680 after conflict with Siam. Foreign merchants participated in an already active maritime world, and monsoon routes linked the coast with wider Southeast Asian markets. Coastal knowledge, safe anchorages, and relations with communities ashore remained essential to vessels whose trade connected the peninsula with distant places around the gulf and beyond.
simp_chinese:
宋卡海岸面向泰国湾，位于马来半岛东侧，潟湖、渔场和耕地支持联系密切的社群。船只把沿海聚落连接到海湾市场，内陆道路则运送产品穿越半岛。稻米、鱼和其他地方货物参与交换，地理位置又促进泰、马来、华人及其他商人和居民接触。资源与交通共同支撑地域生活，也使海岸持续参与文化往来。

十七世纪，设有防御工事的星戈拉港在苏丹苏莱曼沙统治下繁荣；与暹罗长期冲突后，这座城市于1680年遭到毁坏。外国商人参与这里原已活跃的海上贸易，季风航线则把海岸连接到更广阔的东南亚市场。沿海知识、安全锚地和岸上社群关系，对往来海湾及更远地区的船只都很重要。

english: Songkhla Lake is a vast coastal lagoon on the eastern Malay Peninsula, separated from the Gulf of Siam by a long sandbar. Its interconnected waters range from fresh in the northern reaches to brackish near the sea. Fishing communities and old towns grew around its shores, using channels that join the lake to the gulf. Phatthalung, Sathing Phra and Singgora each drew on the lagoon's waters and its access to maritime routes.
simp_chinese: 宋卡湖是马来半岛东岸广阔的沿海潟湖，由一条长沙洲与暹罗湾隔开。相连水域从北部淡水渐变为靠海处的半咸水。渔业社群和古城沿湖发展，利用连接湖泊与海湾的水道。博他仑、沙丁帕和星哥拉都依托潟湖水域及其通往海路的出口。

english: Songming lies northeast of Kunming, among the basins and wooded hills of the Yunnan plateau. The Yuan organised the region as Songmeng, with Yanglin and Shaodian counties under its authority. The Ming retained the prefecture but gradually absorbed both counties, leaving their lands governed directly from Songmeng. In 1482 the name was changed to Songming. The old county seats and their surrounding villages remained part of a district linked by roads to the provincial capital and the eastern approaches to Yunnan.
simp_chinese: 嵩明位于昆明东北的高原，盆地与林丘相间。元代设嵩盟州，辖杨林、邵甸二县。明代沿置州治，逐渐将两县裁并，土地改由州直接管辖；1482年，州名由嵩盟改为嵩明。旧县治和周围村落仍属于这一地区，道路将其与省城及云南东部的入口联系起来。

english:
Songo Mnara was a Swahili stone town on an island near Kilwa Kisiwani off the southern Tanzanian coast. Occupied from the fourteenth to the sixteenth century, it formed part of the Indian Ocean trading world. Its buildings were constructed of coral and mortar; archaeologists have identified mosques, cemeteries, house blocks and enclosed open spaces.

Excavated objects include Kilwa-type coins and ceramics from China and Southeast Asia, evidence of connections beyond the island. Houses, wells, graves and open areas also reveal the organisation of everyday life within the settlement. The stone town was later abandoned, leaving a compact archaeological record of the coastal community.
simp_chinese:
松戈姆纳拉是一座斯瓦希里石城，位于坦桑尼亚南部海岸、基尔瓦基西瓦尼附近的岛上。这里在14至16世纪有人居住，是印度洋贸易世界的一部分。建筑使用珊瑚石和灰浆，考古人员辨认出清真寺、墓地、住宅群与围合的空地。

出土物包括基尔瓦类型的钱币和来自中国、东南亚的陶瓷，显示岛外联系。住宅、水井、墓葬与开放空间也反映聚落日常生活的组织方式。石城后来被废弃，留下这处海岸社群较为集中的考古遗迹。

english: Sōngxī takes its name from the stream that runs through northern Fújiàn. Its banks were once shaded by tall pines, giving rise to the name “Pine Stream.” The district traces its county history to Dōngpíng, established in 260 under the kingdom of Wú. The stream continues southwestward toward the Jiàn River, through a landscape of hills and valleys.
simp_chinese: 松溪因流经闽北的溪流得名。昔日两岸乔松参天，长溪因而得名“松溪”。此地的县治可追溯至三国吴永安三年（260年）设立的东平县。溪水穿过山谷，向西南流往建溪。

english:
Songyang lies in southwestern Zhejiang, within the mountainous country historically administered from Chuzhou. A fertile basin and its surrounding hills gave the county access to both cultivated land and woodland resources. Rice farming occupied suitable valley floors, while households also used gardens, slopes, and forest products. Roads and waterways linked local markets with neighbouring districts, though the terrain made transport more demanding than in Zhejiang's coastal plains.

Songyang belonged to Chuzhou prefecture during the Ming and Qing. Its county seat had moved from Gushi to Xiping in the Tang period after repeated flooding; Gushi nevertheless remained a busy market in later centuries. The Songgu basin was an important agricultural area among the surrounding mountains. County administration and local communities linked these productive lowlands with a more dispersed upland hinterland.
simp_chinese:
松阳位于浙江西南部，属于历史上由处州统辖的山地区域。较肥沃盆地与周围丘陵，使县境同时拥有耕地和林地资源。适宜谷底发展稻作，各户也利用园地、坡地与林产。道路和水路将地方市场同邻区联系起来，但运输比浙江沿海平原更为费力。

明清时期松阳属处州府。县治早在唐代因屡遭水患而从古市迁往西屏，古市在后来的几个世纪仍是繁华集市。松古盆地是群山之间重要的农业地区，县级行政与地方社区将这片低地同较为分散的山地腹地联系起来。

english: The Songye live in the country north of the Luba heartland, among the river valleys of the central African interior. Their traditions link their origins with those of the Luba, including the figure of Kongolo. Songye communities were organised into chiefdoms, and their artistic traditions include the striking kifwebe masks also found among their Luba neighbours.
simp_chinese: 松吉耶人居住在卢巴腹地以北的中非内陆河谷。他们的传统将自身起源与卢巴人联系起来，其中包括孔戈洛这一人物。松吉耶社群由各个酋长领地组成，其艺术传统包括鲜明的基夫韦贝面具；这种面具在相邻的卢巴人中也可见到。

english: Songzhou lay in the country around Chifeng, where the hills of the Mongolian plateau meet the valleys leading toward the Liao River. Its predecessor Songshan County was established by the Liao in 1013. Under Mongol rule it became the seat of Songzhou in 1262, and three years later the county was absorbed into the prefecture. The old settlement formed part of a long succession of administrative centres in the region.
simp_chinese: 松州位于赤峰一带，蒙古高原的丘陵在此接近通往辽河的谷地。辽朝于1013年设松山县；蒙古统治时期，1262年这里成为松州治所，三年后松山县省入州。古城是这一地区历代行政中心之一。

english:
Songzhou stands in the mountain valleys of the upper Min River, at the meeting of routes from the Sichuan Basin and the Tibetan plateau. Its position made Songpan an important frontier town and a meeting place for exchange between Tibetan and Han communities. The steep mountains around it channelled travel toward a small number of passes, giving the settlement strategic importance as well as a role in the tea and horse trade.

The Ming established the garrisons of Songzhou and Panzhou in the late fourteenth century, soon combining them as Songpan. Its fortified town was built against the mountain beside the river; further forts and passes guarded the southern and eastern approaches. Under the Qing, Songpan became a ting in 1731 and was raised to directly administered status in 1760. The walls and outlying defences reflected the town's enduring place on a contested highland frontier.
simp_chinese:
松州坐落在岷江上游山谷，是四川盆地通往藏地高原的道路交会之处。松潘因地势成为重要边镇，也是藏汉社群交易往来的场所。周围群山迫使行旅经过有限的山口，使这里既有军事意义，也参与茶马贸易。

十四世纪末，明朝设置松州、潘州二卫，不久合并为松潘卫。城池依山傍江修筑，南路与东路另设关堡守御。清雍正九年（1731）改设松潘厅，乾隆二十五年（1760）升为直隶厅。城墙与外围防御设施，反映了这座高地边镇长期以来的重要地位。

english: Songzhou lay in the valley of the Yi River amid the mountains south of Luoyang. During the wars between Song and Jin, the former Yiyang County was raised to the status of a prefecture; the Jin later called it Songzhou. The Ming reduced the prefecture to Song County. In 1369 the commander Ren Liang rebuilt its defences, and the walls were repaired again in the early Qing. In 1476 land east of the county was separated to establish a new Yiyang County.
simp_chinese: 嵩州位于洛阳以南群山之间的伊河谷地。宋金战争期间，原伊阳县升为州，金代改称嵩州；明朝则降州为嵩县。1369年，指挥任亮重建城防，清初城墙再次修筑。1476年，嵩县东部的一部分土地划出，与邻近地区合设新的伊阳县。

english: Sōngzī lies on the waterways south of the Yangtze in the Jīngzhōu region. Its old county seat endured for many centuries, while settlements along the river supported trade and travel. Wànshì was already one of the county’s noted markets in the Míng, a landing place on the Yangtze where boats and goods moved along the river.
simp_chinese: 松滋位于荆州一带的长江南岸水网中。旧县城延续了许多世纪，沿江聚落则维系着贸易和交通。涴市在明代已是县内著名市镇之一，江上的船只和货物在此停靠往来。

english:
Sonhat was a seat of the rulers of Korea, a small state among the forested hills west of Surguja. Its country contained older strongholds, including Koreagarh, a hilltop site with ruins and a stepped well. Local tradition remembers successive Baland and Kol chiefs before the later ruling family established its authority.

In 1797 the Maratha officer Gulab Khan attacked Sonhat with troops from Ratanpur, assisted by forces sent by the ruler of Surguja. Raja Garib Singh was compelled to pay chauth, and the invading force ravaged the countryside. On its return it was attacked near Latma by the zamindar of Patna. In 1819 Garib Singh agreed to pay an annual tribute to the East India Company, bringing Korea into a new relationship with the expanding power.
simp_chinese:
索恩哈特是科里亚统治者的驻地，这个小国坐落在苏尔古贾以西的林间丘陵。境内有更早的据点，包括山顶上的科里亚加尔遗址及阶梯井。地方传统记住了巴兰德人与科尔人的历代首领，后来才出现新的统治家族。

1797年，马拉塔官员古拉布汗率拉坦布尔部队袭击索恩哈特，苏尔古贾统治者也派兵协助。拉贾加里布·辛格被迫缴纳乔特税，入侵军队劫掠乡村，返程时在拉特马附近遭帕特纳扎明达尔袭击。1819年，加里布·辛格同意每年向东印度公司进贡，科里亚由此与不断扩张的势力建立新的关系。

english: Sonisa lies in the Yeşilırmak valley east of Amasya, among the hills between the interior and the Black Sea. The settlement gave its name to an Ottoman district of villages and cultivated land. Sixteenth-century tax records describe both Muslim and Christian inhabitants in the surrounding countryside. A mosque and a bath associated with Sinan Pasha recall the town's place in the region's Ottoman history.
simp_chinese: 索尼萨位于阿马西亚以东的耶希尔河谷，坐落在内陆与黑海之间的丘陵地带。聚落为一个包括村庄和耕地的奥斯曼辖区命名。十六世纪税册记载，周围乡村既有穆斯林，也有基督徒居民。与锡南帕夏有关的清真寺和浴室，体现了城镇在当地奥斯曼历史中的地位。

english: Sonmiani Bay opens onto the Arabian Sea at the eastern end of the Makran coast. Behind a sandy peninsula lies Miani Hor, a shallow lagoon connected to the sea and fringed by mangroves. Sonmiani was a port for Las Bela, with maritime connections to India and the Persian Gulf. In 1808, Qasimi raiders captured and plundered the port, disrupting its trade for several years.
simp_chinese: 松米亚尼湾位于马克兰海岸东端，朝向阿拉伯海。沙质半岛后方的米亚尼霍尔是一片与大海相通的浅潟湖，岸边生长着红树林。松米亚尼曾是拉斯贝拉的港口，海路通向印度和波斯湾。1808年，卡西米袭击者攻占并劫掠港口，使贸易中断了数年。

english: Sönöd is the pasture country of the Sönöd Mongols on the steppe south of the Gobi. The group was among the Chahar in the late Ming period and traced its name to the earlier Sönit. Its leaders submitted to Hong Taiji, and in 1641 and 1642 the Qing organised the people into left and right banners. Both became part of the Xilingol League, meeting with neighbouring Mongol banners at the river from which the league took its name.
simp_chinese: 苏尼特是戈壁以南苏尼特蒙古人的牧地。明末该部属于察哈尔，名称可追溯至更早的雪你惕。部落首领归附皇太极后，清廷于1641和1642年将其分别编为左右两旗。两旗后来属于锡林郭勒盟，与邻近蒙古旗在盟名所来自的河流附近会盟。

english: Along the northern Californian coast, Pomo communities gathered seaweed and shellfish, caught fish, and hunted game on land. Farther south, in Kashaya Pomo territory, the Russian-American Company founded Fort Ross in 1812. Russian settlers and Alaska Native hunters sought sea otter pelts along the coast, while farming at the settlement helped supply Russia's colonies in Alaska.
simp_chinese: 在加利福尼亚北部海岸，波莫人采集海藻和贝类，捕鱼，也在陆上狩猎。1812年，俄美公司在更南面的卡沙亚波莫人土地上建立罗斯堡。俄国移民与阿拉斯加原住民猎手沿海捕猎海獭，获取毛皮；堡垒附近的农耕则帮助供应俄国在阿拉斯加的殖民地。

english: Sonqor lies in the mountainous country northeast of Kermanshah. On a hill in the town stands the octagonal tomb known as the Malek shrine. Its lower chamber is built of dressed stone, while the upper tower and dome are of brick. Pointed arches and patterned brickwork ornament its sides, with touches of turquoise tile. The identity of the person commemorated by the tomb has been remembered in different ways by local tradition.
simp_chinese: 松库尔位于克尔曼沙阿东北的山区。城中一座山丘上耸立着八角形的马利克墓，形如高塔。下层墓室由凿好的石块建成，上层塔身和穹顶则用砖砌。尖拱、花纹砖饰与点缀其间的绿松石色瓷砖装饰着建筑外壁。关于墓主人是谁，当地流传着不同的说法。

english: The Pacific coast near Buenaventura is a country of bays, tidal channels and humid forest west of the Cauca valley. Indigenous communities inhabited the shore before Spanish expeditions arrived. In 1540 Pascual de Andagoya’s expedition explored the bay, and his lieutenant Juan Ladrillero began a settlement there. The port offered a connection between the Pacific and routes crossing the Western Cordillera toward Cali and the interior.
simp_chinese: 布埃纳文图拉附近的太平洋海岸位于考卡河谷以西，海湾、潮汐水道和湿润森林交错。西班牙远征队到来之前，原住民社群已居住在岸边。1540年，帕斯夸尔·德安达戈亚的远征队探索海湾，其副手胡安·拉德里列罗开始在此建立聚落。港口将太平洋与翻越西部山脉通往卡利和内陆的道路相连。

english: Sontang lies in the northern Minangkabau borderlands, among streams that drain the hills towards the Rokan basin. The Sontang watercourse is part of this network of tributaries, which carries water away from the highlands of Pasaman into the plains to the east. Forested slopes and river valleys shape a landscape between the mountain country of western Sumatra and the great lowland rivers that reach the Strait of Malacca.
simp_chinese: 松唐位于米南加保北部边缘，周围溪流从丘陵流向罗干河流域。松唐水道是这一支流网络的一部分，将帕萨曼高地的水带入东部平原。森林覆盖的山坡与河谷构成当地景观；这里处在苏门答腊西部山地与通往马六甲海峡的低地大河之间。

english: Sontecomapan Lagoon lies on the Gulf coast beneath the mountains of Los Tuxtlas. Streams descend from the slopes into its shallow waters, which are bordered by mangroves and connected to the sea by a narrow channel. A sandbar and rocky ground frame the opening. The lagoon forms a sheltered meeting place of freshwater and seawater on a coast where volcanic hills rise close to the Gulf.
simp_chinese: 松特科马潘潟湖位于墨西哥湾沿岸、图斯特拉斯群山脚下。溪流从山坡汇入浅水，潟湖周围生长着红树林，并通过狭窄水道与大海相连；沙洲与岩石分列入口两侧。在火山丘陵紧邻海湾的海岸上，这片潟湖为淡水与海水的交汇提供庇护。

english: Sonthofen lies near the northern edge of the Allgäu Alps, where the Iller and Ostrach rivers meet. In 1429 King Sigismund granted it the right to hold a weekly market and an annual fair, strengthening its role among the surrounding communities. In February 1525 rebellious peasants from the Allgäu gathered here at the beginning of the German Peasants' War. Sonthofen belonged to the prince-bishopric of Augsburg until the territorial changes of 1803 brought it to Bavaria. From 1812 it developed as a centre of cattle trading, drawing buyers and sellers from the Alpine countries.
simp_chinese: 松特霍芬位于阿尔高阿尔卑斯山北缘附近，伊勒河与奥斯特拉赫河在此汇合。1429年，国王西吉斯蒙德授予当地举办周市和年度集市的权利，加强了它在周边社群中的作用。1525年2月，阿尔高的起义农民在此集会，成为德国农民战争初期的一幕。松特霍芬原属奥格斯堡主教领地，1803年领土重组后归入巴伐利亚。1812年起，它逐渐发展为牲畜贸易中心，吸引阿尔卑斯各地的买卖者。

english: Soo lies in eastern Ōsumi, where inland plains lead toward the harbour of Shibushi. In the Middle Ages the port served the vast Shimazu estate, whose lands extended across Ōsumi, Satsuma and Hyūga. Shimazu Ujihisa, who held Shibushi Castle, sent an envoy to Ming China in 1374. Imported objects found at the castle recall the maritime connections that linked this southern coast with China and Southeast Asia.
simp_chinese: 曾于位于大隅东部，内陆平原通向志布志港。中世纪，这座港口服务于广大的岛津庄，庄园横跨大隅、萨摩与日向。以志布志城为居所的岛津氏久于1374年派遣使者前往明朝。城址出土的舶来物品，见证了南部海岸与中国、东南亚的海上联系。

english:
On the north shore of Great Slave Lake, Yellowknife Bay opens into a country of lakes, woods and rocky ground. The Yellowknives Dene and their Tłı̨chǫ neighbours travelled and hunted in this region, while the bay’s fisheries supplied food to generations of Dene families. The English name recalls the copper blades used by the Yellowknives.

A trading post known as Fort Providence was established near the bay in the late eighteenth century. Dene hunters brought caribou meat to its traders, who sent some of the surplus to other posts on the lake. In 1820 the Yellowknives leader Akaitcho met John Franklin there and agreed to guide and provision his expedition north. When Franklin’s party returned starving the following year, Akaitcho and his hunters came to their aid.
simp_chinese:
大奴湖北岸的黄刀湾通向一片湖泊、森林与岩石交错的土地。黄刀德内人及其特利乔邻人曾在这一带旅行狩猎，湾中的渔场也为世代德内家庭提供食物。黄刀湾的英文名称，让人想起黄刀人使用的铜刃。

十八世纪末，湾附近建立了名为普罗维登斯堡的贸易站。德内猎人带来驯鹿肉，商人将部分余粮送往湖上的其他据点。1820年，黄刀人首领阿凯乔在此会见约翰·富兰克林，同意为他的北行探险队担任向导并提供补给。次年探险队饥饿而归，阿凯乔和猎人们又前往救援。

english:
Soonpur belongs to the Kangra region of the western Himalayan foothills, where valleys and ridges separate small districts. Cultivation depends on suitable slopes, river terraces and water, while forests and pasture supplement village resources. Hill routes carry traders, pilgrims and officials between local communities and the Punjab plains.

In the later medieval and early modern periods, Kangra was associated with Rajput rulers and a fortress sought by larger powers. Mughal influence extended into the hills, while local chiefs and village institutions continued to shape government. Temples linked dispersed settlements through pilgrimage. In the eighteenth century, weakening Mughal authority brought further struggles among hill rulers, Sikh powers and other regional forces.
simp_chinese:
松普尔属于喜马拉雅西部山麓的冈格拉地区，河谷与山脊分隔出较小的地方区域。居民利用适宜耕作的坡地、河阶和水源，也从森林与牧场取得资源。山路供商人、朝圣者和官员通行，将村落与旁遮普平原联系起来。

中世纪后期至近代早期，冈格拉与拉其普特统治家族和一座重要山堡相关，较大政权也争取控制此地。莫卧儿势力进入山区后，地方首领和村社仍影响日常治理。寺庙通过朝圣联系分散聚落。十八世纪莫卧儿权威衰弱后，山地统治者、锡克势力和其他区域力量继续争夺。

english:
Sopron stands near the western boundary of the Hungarian kingdom, on the site of the Roman town of Scarbantia. Its medieval walls enclosed a community of merchants and craftsmen whose connections reached toward Austria as well as the Hungarian interior. King Ladislaus IV rewarded the town with royal privileges in 1277.

Sopron remained an important meeting place in the wars and religious disputes of early modern Hungary. A great fire in 1676 destroyed much of the medieval town, and the houses rebuilt afterward gave its centre a new Baroque appearance. In 1681 the Hungarian Diet met here, bringing the kingdom's estates together in the western border town. The town tower, raised after the fire, came to overlook the streets and squares of the rebuilt city.
simp_chinese:
肖普朗位于匈牙利王国西部边界附近，建在罗马城镇斯卡尔班提亚的旧址上。中世纪城墙围住商人和工匠的社区，他们的联系既通往奥地利，也通向匈牙利腹地。1277年，拉斯洛四世国王授予城镇王室特权。

在近代早期匈牙利的战争与宗教争端中，肖普朗仍是重要的集会地点。1676年大火摧毁了大部分中世纪城镇，此后重建的房屋使中心区呈现新的巴洛克面貌。1681年，匈牙利议会在这里召开，王国各等级在这座西部边境城镇聚会。火灾后增高的市镇塔俯瞰着重建后的街道和广场。

english: Sora lies in the valley of the Liri, where the river passes between the mountains of central Italy. A castle on the height above the town guarded the valley and the routes towards the Kingdom of Naples. Destroyed by Frederick II in 1229, Sora later became a royal city under Charles of Anjou before passing through the hands of several noble families. The Della Rovere held it from 1475, and the Boncompagni from 1612 until it returned to the Crown in 1796.
simp_chinese: 索拉位于利里河谷，河流在意大利中部群山之间穿行。镇上高地的城堡守护河谷与通往那不勒斯王国的道路。1229年，腓特烈二世摧毁索拉；安茹的查理后来将它设为王室城市，此后又先后归属多个贵族家族。德拉罗韦雷家族自1475年持有此地，邦孔帕尼家族自1612年统治，直到1796年领地回归王室。

english: The Sorachi River winds through the interior of Ezo, from mountain valleys through the Furano basin to the Ishikari. Its Ainu name is said to refer to the tumbling waters of the great falls on its middle course. Ainu from the Ishikari and Kamikawa districts hunted and traveled in the basin; routes following its upper waters also led across the mountains toward Tokachi. The river connected a landscape of wooded hills and settlements with the larger Ishikari system.
simp_chinese: 空知川蜿蜒穿过虾夷地内陆，从山谷流经富良野盆地，最终汇入石狩川。河名据说源于阿伊努语，指的是中游大瀑布奔涌的水流。石狩和上川地区的阿伊努人曾在流域狩猎、往来，沿上游还可越山通往十胜。河流把森林丘陵与聚落所在的地域同更大的石狩水系联系起来。

english: Soras lies in the highlands of southern Peru, beneath the mountain revered locally as Payacca. The Sora people inhabited the valleys of this region before their incorporation into the Inca Empire. The great Inca road connected their country with neighbouring Andean provinces, and early Spanish chroniclers recorded a settlement called Soras along the route. In the sixteenth century the region became associated with Taki Onqoy, an indigenous religious movement responding to Spanish rule.
simp_chinese: 索拉斯位于秘鲁南部高地，坐落在当地人敬奉的帕亚卡山下。索拉人居住在这一地区的河谷，后来被纳入印加帝国。印加大道将他们的土地与邻近安第斯诸省相连，早期西班牙编年史作者记载了道路上的索拉斯聚落。十六世纪，这一地区与回应西班牙统治的原住民宗教运动塔基翁科伊联系在一起。

english: Sorbulaq occupies a natural closed depression on the dry foothill plain north of the Trans-Ili Alatau. Saline lakes lay in the basin, with no river outlet to carry away the salts left as water evaporated. Beyond it the plain slopes toward the Ili valley, while the mountains rise to the south. The hollows of this arid country collect water locally rather than draining directly to a sea.
simp_chinese: 索尔布拉克位于外伊犁阿拉套山以北干燥山前平原的一处天然封闭洼地。盆地中有咸水湖泊，没有河流出口带走水分蒸发后留下的盐分。洼地之外，平原向伊犁河谷倾斜，南方则耸立着群山；这片干旱土地上的低地将水汇集在局部，而非直接排入海洋。

english: Sordavala, also known as Sortavala or Serdobol, stands at the northern end of Lake Ladoga among the islands and inlets of its rugged shore. The district appears in Swedish documents in 1468 and in Russian records in 1500. Its position linked the Karelian communities of the northern shore with the lake and the routes beyond it. After the Ingrian War the district passed to Sweden. The Treaty of Nystad in 1721 returned it to Russia, and the town became known as Serdobol. Its marble and granite quarries supplied stone for imperial building projects in St Petersburg and its surroundings. In 1812, with the rest of Viipuri Province, it became part of the Grand Duchy of Finland.
simp_chinese: 索尔达瓦拉又称索尔塔瓦拉或谢尔多博尔，位于拉多加湖北端崎岖湖岸的岛屿和海湾之间。该地区见于1468年的瑞典文献和1500年的俄国记录。它的位置将北岸的卡累利阿社群与湖面及更远的交通路线连接起来。英格里亚战争后，地区转归瑞典。1721年的《尼斯塔德条约》使它重归俄罗斯，城镇以谢尔多博尔之名为人所知。当地大理石和花岗岩采石场为圣彼得堡及周边的帝国建筑工程提供石材。1812年，它与维堡省其他地区一起并入芬兰大公国。

english:
Sorgono lies in the interior of Sardinia, in the upland district of Mandrolisai. In the Middle Ages it belonged to the giudicato of Arborea and served as a centre of the district. The settlement appears in a regional list of inhabited places in 1338.

After Arborea's defeat, Sorgono passed under Aragonese rule. In 1507 it shared a privilege with other Mandrolisai villages: the crown chose a local official from three candidates presented annually by the inhabitants. The rural sanctuary of San Mauro, built in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries, became a centre of worship and popular festivities.
simp_chinese:
索尔戈诺位于撒丁岛内陆的曼德罗利赛山地。中世纪，它属于阿尔博雷阿审判国，并曾是该地区的中心。1338年的区域聚落名单中记有此地。

阿尔博雷阿战败后，索尔戈诺转入阿拉贡统治。1507年，它与曼德罗利赛其他村庄共同获得一项特权：居民每年提出三名候选人，由王室从中选择本地官员。乡间的圣毛罗圣所建于十五至十六世纪，后来成为礼拜和民间节庆的中心。

english: Sorgun lies east of Yozgat on the central Anatolian plateau. Nearby Alişar Höyük preserves traces of a much older settlement, while the surrounding plains supported farming and pastoral communities. Under the Ottomans Sorgun was a rural district of Bozok, a region named for Oghuz Turkmen groups. Sixteenth-century records list its villages as part of a network of settlements across the plateau.
simp_chinese: 索尔贡位于约兹加特以东的安纳托利亚高原。附近阿利沙尔土丘保存着更古老聚落的痕迹，周围平原则养育农耕和牧业社群。奥斯曼时期，索尔贡是博佐克的一个乡区；博佐克得名于乌古斯土库曼部众。十六世纪文献列出了其村庄，呈现高原上相互联系的聚落网络。

english: Sori lies south of Kandi beside the Alibori, a river that flows north towards the Niger. Kandi became the centre of a kingdom in the Borgu country, linked by its ruling family to Nikki. In the first half of the eighteenth century, Wasangari aristocrats from Nikki established themselves among the existing Mokole communities of Kandi and Guéné. Local tradition remembers Saka Baku, a prince of Nikki, as the founder of Kandi's ruling house.
simp_chinese: 索里位于坎迪以南、阿利博里河畔，河水向北流往尼日尔河。坎迪后来成为博尔古地区一个王国的中心，其统治家族与尼基有关。十八世纪上半叶，来自尼基的瓦桑加里贵族在坎迪和盖内原有的莫科莱社群中确立统治地位。当地传说将尼基王子萨卡·巴库视为坎迪王室的建立者。

english: Soria stands on the Duero in the high country of Castile. Its position near the medieval frontiers of Castile, Navarre and Aragon made it a strategic settlement. Repopulated under Alfonso I of Aragon, it received a charter in 1120 and passed under Alfonso VII after 1134. Soria prospered in the later Middle Ages through its frontier position and livestock economy. Its walls, Romanesque churches and later Renaissance houses reflect the town's long history. The union of Castile and Aragon changed its strategic importance, and the expulsion of Jews in 1492 also affected the town. During the War of the Spanish Succession it supported Philip V; in 1808 French troops captured and burned it during the Peninsular War.
simp_chinese: 索里亚位于卡斯蒂利亚高地的杜罗河畔。它靠近中世纪卡斯蒂利亚、纳瓦拉和阿拉贡的边界，因而具有战略价值。阿拉贡的阿方索一世统治期间，这里重新定居，1120年获得特许状；1134年后转归阿方索七世。中世纪后期，边境位置和畜牧经济使索里亚繁荣。城墙、罗曼式教堂以及后来的文艺复兴时期宅邸，反映了城镇的悠久历史。卡斯蒂利亚与阿拉贡联合改变了它的战略地位，1492年驱逐犹太人也影响当地。西班牙王位继承战争中，索里亚支持腓力五世；1808年半岛战争期间，法军攻占并焚烧了城镇。

english: Sorin Nuur lies in the eastern reaches of the Xilingol grasslands, on the broad Mongolian Plateau. To the east, the Ulagai River crosses a steppe region rich in natural pasture, rivers and wetlands before disappearing into an inland basin. These grasslands form part of a wider pastoral world extending across the plateau, where Mongolian language and herding traditions have endured alongside the varied waterways of the steppe.
simp_chinese: 索林淖尔位于锡林郭勒草原东部，地处广阔的蒙古高原。东面的乌拉盖河流经天然牧场、河流与湿地丰富的草原地带，最终汇入内陆盆地。这些草地属于横贯高原的广大牧业世界，蒙古语言与放牧传统在草原各式水道之间延续至今。

english: Sorkam lies on the western coast of northern Sumatra, south of the old port of Barus. In the early eighteenth century a dispute within the ruling family of Barus led to the establishment of an independent Sultanate of Sorkam. The graves of its rulers preserve the memory of this coastal court, which emerged among the small polities facing the Indian Ocean.
simp_chinese: 索尔卡姆位于苏门答腊北部西岸，在古港巴鲁斯以南。十八世纪初，巴鲁斯统治家族内部的争端促成了独立的索尔卡姆苏丹国建立。统治者的墓葬保存着这座沿海宫廷的记忆；它是面向印度洋的众多小政权之一。

english: Soroca stands beside the Dniester at a river crossing on Moldavia's eastern frontier. A wooden fort attributed to Prince Stephen the Great guarded the ford and formed part of a wider chain of Moldavian defences. Between 1543 and 1546, under Petru Rareș, it was rebuilt in stone as a circular fortress with five towers. Its walls and gun positions reflected the need to defend this crossing against forces approaching along the river. During the wars between the Ottoman Empire and its neighbours the fortress remained important, including during Peter the Great's Pruth campaign in 1711. The town's position joined the movement of people and goods along the Dniester to the demands of a contested frontier.
simp_chinese: 索罗卡位于德涅斯特河畔，扼守摩尔达维亚东部边境的渡口。相传由斯特凡大公建立的木堡守护着渡河点，是摩尔达维亚防御链的一环。1543至1546年，佩特鲁·拉雷什统治时，堡垒改建为圆形石堡，设有五座塔楼。城墙和炮位反映出防守河流通道的需要。奥斯曼帝国与邻国的战争中，堡垒继续具有军事意义，包括彼得大帝1711年的普鲁特河战役时期。索罗卡的河畔位置把人员货物的往来同边境防御联系起来。

english:
Sorocaba stands on the river of the same name in the interior of São Paulo. Founded in 1654 by Baltazar Fernandes, the settlement grew into a major meeting place for drovers and merchants. Its position on the routes between southern pastures and the mining districts made it a centre of the mule trade, upon which much of inland transport depended.

In 1733 Cristóvão Pereira de Abreu brought a large drove of animals through Sorocaba along the route from the south. Traffic increased, and after a registration post was established near the river bridge around 1750, the passage of droves and the holding of mule fairs became regular features of the town. Traders bought animals for journeys to São Paulo and the mines of Minas Gerais. The crowds attracted by the fairs encouraged local commerce and crafts, while the animals carried goods and travellers over difficult inland roads.
simp_chinese:
索罗卡巴位于圣保罗内陆的同名河流畔。1654年，巴尔塔扎尔·费尔南德斯建立了这座聚落，它后来发展为赶牲口的人与商贩的重要集会地。这里处于南方牧场和矿区之间的道路上，成为骡子贸易中心，而内陆运输很大程度上依赖这些牲畜。

1733年，克里斯托旺·佩雷拉·迪阿布雷乌沿南方路线赶着大批牲畜经过索罗卡巴。随着往来增加，约1750年河桥附近设立牲畜登记站，畜群通过和骡市举行逐渐成为镇上的常事。商人购买牲畜，用于前往圣保罗和米纳斯吉拉斯矿区的旅程。集市吸引的人群促进了当地商业与手工业，骡子则在艰难的内陆道路上运送货物和旅客。

english: Sorochinskaya began as a fortress on the Samara River. In the spring of 1736 Pyotr Bakhmetyev arrived to build it near the mouth of the Sorochka, but high water forced him to select a site farther upstream. The fort retained the intended name and was garrisoned by service men, including Yaik Cossacks; its first ataman was Aleksei Sokolov. In 1773 Yemelyan Pugachev occupied the fortress during his rebellion and used it as a gathering and observation point for his forces.
simp_chinese: 索罗钦斯卡亚最初是萨马拉河畔的一座堡垒。1736年春，彼得·巴赫梅捷夫奉命在索罗奇卡河口附近建堡，但洪水迫使他在上游另选地址。堡垒仍沿用原定名称，驻有包括雅伊克哥萨克在内的服役人员；首任阿塔曼为阿列克谢·索科洛夫。1773年起义期间，叶梅利扬·普加乔夫占领这座堡垒，将其作为部队集结和观察的据点。

english: Sorokogne lies in the inland country of Saloum, where a megalithic site forms part of the wider Senegambian landscape of stone circles and burial mounds. Nearby Wanar and Sine Ngayène contain groups of carefully shaped laterite pillars associated with graves. Their builders used iron tools to quarry and fashion the stones, maintaining a monumental tradition over many centuries. The Saloum country later became home to a Serer kingdom linked to the wider politics of Jolof.
simp_chinese: 索罗孔涅位于萨卢姆内陆，当地巨石遗址属于塞内冈比亚更广阔的石圈与墓丘景观。附近的瓦纳尔和锡内恩加延有成群的红土石柱，与墓葬相联系。营建者使用铁器开采、加工石料，历经多个世纪维持这一巨石传统。萨卢姆地区后来出现塞雷尔人王国，并与乔洛夫更广阔的政治世界相连。

sources.title: Liste des monuments et sites historiques de la région de Kaffrine

english: Sorsele lies on the Vindel River, whose branches flow around the island where its church stands. Long before Swedish settlers arrived, Sámi people used the surrounding country for hunting, fishing and reindeer herding. In the seventeenth century, as the Swedish state strengthened its presence in Lapland and encouraged settlement, the priest Henrik Lyckselius established himself here. Sorsele developed as a place of worship and trade for the inhabitants of the river country.
simp_chinese: 索瑟勒位于温德尔河畔，河水分支环绕着教堂所在的岛屿。瑞典移民到来以前很久，萨米人便在周边地区狩猎、捕鱼和放牧驯鹿。十七世纪，瑞典国家加强了在拉普兰的存在并鼓励移民定居，牧师亨里克·吕克塞利乌斯在此落脚。索瑟勒逐渐成为河流沿岸居民礼拜和交易的地方。

english: Sortol lies in the eastern Central Yakutian Lowland, in marshy country dotted with lakes and alas depressions. These hollows break up the forested landscape of the Vilyuy basin. The climate is sharply continental, with a long, cold winter and a brief summer, and the low-lying ground holds water among the surrounding woods.
simp_chinese: 索尔托尔位于中雅库特低地东部，周围沼泽广布，点缀着湖泊和阿拉斯洼地。这些洼地打破了维柳伊河流域森林的连续景观。这里属强烈的大陆性气候，冬季漫长寒冷，夏季短暂；低洼处积聚的水域散布在林地之间。

english:
Sos stands on a rocky height in northern Aragon, close to the historic border with Navarre. Its castle and walls reflect the town's position between the two kingdoms; the surviving medieval defenses include gates that once controlled access to its streets.

During the Navarrese civil war, Queen Juana Enríquez came to Sos and gave birth there in 1452 to Ferdinand, later king of Aragon. The town also had a medieval Jewish quarter; the expulsion decree of 1492 forced its Jewish inhabitants to leave or convert. In 1711 Sos was designated the capital of the Cinco Villas district.
simp_chinese:
索斯坐落在阿拉贡北部的岩石高地，靠近与纳瓦拉的历史边界。城堡和城墙反映了它在两国之间的位置；保存下来的中世纪防御设施中，包括曾控制城镇出入的城门。

纳瓦拉内战期间，王后胡安娜·恩里克斯来到索斯，于1452年在此生下后来成为阿拉贡国王的斐迪南。镇上也有中世纪犹太人街区；1492年的驱逐令迫使犹太居民离开或改宗。1711年，索斯被定为辛科比利亚斯地区的首府。

english: Soscumica lies beside a broad, angular lake formed by the Nottaway River downstream from Lake Matagami. The lake bends from a north–south reach into an east–west arm, its width varying along the wooded shores. The Nottaway continues northwest from this lake towards Rupert Bay and James Bay. Soscumica may come from a Cree expression describing slippery ground or shores, a name recalling the character of the lakeside terrain.
simp_chinese: 索斯库米卡位于一片宽阔而曲折的湖泊旁。诺塔韦河从马塔加米湖流出后，在这里扩展成湖。湖面由南北走向的一段转入东西延伸的水湾，森林环绕的湖岸之间宽窄不一。诺塔韦河从湖中继续向西北流往鲁珀特湾与詹姆斯湾。索斯库米卡可能源自克里语中形容湿滑地面或湖岸的词，反映了当地的地形。

english: Sosnovy Ostrov, the Pine Island, began as a Russian watch post on an island in the Volga in the sixteenth century. It developed into a fishing settlement belonging to Moscow's Chudov Monastery, whose lands and fisheries extended along the river. In 1606 the settlement moved to the mainland, where it became the village of Sosnovy Ostrov. Catherine II made it a district town in 1780; thereafter it was known as Khvalynsk. The river and its fisheries remained central to the life of this settlement beneath the hills of the Volga's right bank.
simp_chinese: 索斯诺维奥斯特罗夫意为“松岛”，起初是十六世纪设在伏尔加河岛上的俄罗斯哨所，后来发展为一处渔业聚落，属于莫斯科的丘多夫修道院。修道院的土地与渔场沿河延伸。1606年，聚落迁至大陆，成为索斯诺维奥斯特罗夫村。1780年，叶卡捷琳娜二世将它升为县城，此后称作赫瓦伦斯克。河流及其渔场始终是伏尔加河右岸丘陵下这座聚落生活的重要部分。

english: Sosnytsia lies on the Ubid, a tributary of the Desna, amid the pine forests from which its name is thought to derive. The Hypatian Chronicle mentions the town in 1234 during the wars of the Rus' princes. It later passed through Lithuanian and Muscovite hands before the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth recovered the region in 1618. A fortress was built in 1634, and in 1648 the Cossack uprising brought the town into the struggle for control of the Severian lands.
simp_chinese: 索斯尼齐亚位于杰斯纳河支流乌比季河畔，四周的松林被认为是其名称的来源。《伊帕季编年史》在1234年罗斯诸侯战争的记载中提到这座城镇。它后来先后归立陶宛和莫斯科，1618年波兰立陶宛联邦重新取得这一地区。1634年城中建起要塞；1648年哥萨克起义使索斯尼齐亚卷入谢韦里亚土地的争夺。

english: Sosola lies among the hills between the Mixteca Alta and the central valleys of Oaxaca. Its Mixtec communities retained their lands and local institutions through colonial rule. A dispute in 1775 between the people of San Juan Sosola and San Jerónimo Sosola drew on a land deed written in Mixtec, showing how Indigenous-language documents remained important in defending claims to fields and boundaries long after the Spanish conquest.
simp_chinese: 索索拉位于米斯特卡阿尔塔与瓦哈卡中央谷地之间的丘陵中。殖民统治期间，当地米斯特克社群维持着土地与地方制度。1775年，圣胡安索索拉与圣赫罗尼莫索索拉居民的争地诉讼引用了一份米斯特克语土地契约，显示西班牙征服很久之后，原住民语言文书仍是维护田地与边界权利的重要依据。

english: Sosso was the centre of a kingdom that rose in the western Sudan after the decline of Ghana. Its rulers extended their power over neighbouring lands before the emergence of Mali. The best remembered of them, Sumanguru Kante, appears in Manding oral traditions as the formidable opponent of Sundiata Keita. Sundiata’s victory in the thirteenth century became a defining episode in the story of Mali. The old name of Sosso survives in the country between the Sahel and the upper Niger.
simp_chinese: 索索是西苏丹的一个王国中心，在加纳衰落后兴起。其统治者在马里崛起之前将势力扩展到邻近地区。最为人所记忆的统治者苏曼古鲁·坎特，在曼丁口述传统中是松迪亚塔·凯塔强大的对手。十三世纪松迪亚塔的胜利成为马里历史叙事中的决定性篇章。索索的古名至今留存在萨赫勒与尼日尔河上游之间的土地上。

english: Sosura lies at the northeastern edge of Korea, near the mouth of the Tumen River and the coast of the East Sea. The nearby shore bends around bays and headlands, while the river reaches the sea from the northern frontier. This coastal corner joins the mountainous Korean interior to the lower Tumen country, where land and sea routes meet near the peninsula's northern end.
simp_chinese: 西水罗位于朝鲜东北端，靠近图们江口和东海海岸。附近海岸环绕着海湾与岬角，图们江则从北方边疆流入大海。这片沿海角落连接着朝鲜山地内陆与图们江下游地区，陆路和海路在半岛北端附近交会。

english: The Sosva rises in the northern Urals and flows eastward to join the Lozva, forming the Tavda in the Tobol basin. Its upper course is called the Bolshaya Sosva. Forests surround the river and its tributaries, among them the Turya. Copper mining began on the Turya in 1758, when the Verkhoturye merchant Maksim Pokhodyashin opened the first of several mines. Their products supplied the growing metalworks of the Ural foothills.
simp_chinese: 索斯瓦河发源于北乌拉尔，向东流去，与洛兹瓦河汇合形成托博尔河流域的塔夫达河。其上游称为大索斯瓦河。森林环绕河流及其支流，其中包括图里亚河。1758年，韦尔霍图里耶商人马克西姆·波霍佳申在图里亚河开办第一座铜矿，后来又开发数座矿场，供应乌拉尔山麓不断发展的冶金厂。

english: Sotachiro is associated with the Nutabe inhabitants of the Valle de los Osos, in the highlands of northern Antioquia. Local accounts place a possible Indigenous settlement of that name near the headwaters of the Guadalupe River. Spanish governors Andrés de Valdivia and Gaspar de Rodas visited the valley in the sixteenth century, but it remained sparsely settled by colonists for a long time. Gold later drew settlers into the surrounding highlands.
simp_chinese: 索塔奇罗与安蒂奥基亚北部熊谷高地的努塔韦人有关。地方记述认为，瓜达卢佩河源头附近可能曾有一个同名原住民聚落。十六世纪，西班牙总督安德烈斯·德·巴尔迪维亚和加斯帕尔·德·罗达斯到过这座山谷，但此后很长时间殖民者仍然稀少。黄金后来吸引移民进入周围高地。

english:
Sotk lies in the highland country east of Lake Sevan, where mountain passes connect neighboring basins. In medieval times it belonged to the Armenian region of Syunik and stood on the road between Dvin and Partav, linking parts of the South Caucasus. Its position made the crossing important to movement beyond the immediate district.

The village church of St Astvatsatsin preserves medieval khachkars, carved stone crosses, in its walls. The surrounding highlands also experienced changing political control as larger powers contested the region. Cold conditions and mountain terrain shaped travel and the use of pasture, while routes through the passes tied local communities to a wider landscape.
simp_chinese:
索特克位于塞凡湖以东高地，山口连接相邻盆地。中世纪时，它属于亚美尼亚的休尼克地区，处在德温通往帕尔塔夫的道路上，联系外高加索不同地区。这个位置使山间通道的作用超出了当地范围。

村中的圣阿斯特瓦察钦教堂墙体保存着中世纪的哈奇卡尔，即雕刻十字石碑。周围高地也经历了较大势力争夺带来的统治变迁。寒冷环境和山地地形影响交通与牧场利用，而穿越山口的道路将当地社群同更广阔地区联系起来。

english: Sotkamo lies among the lakes and wooded hills of southeastern Kainuu. Settlers arriving from Savolax and Ostrobothnia first belonged to the parish around Oulujärvi, and travelled to Paltaniemi for worship. A local preaching house and priest are recorded by 1630, and Sotkamo became an independent parish in 1647. Its scattered farms were served by numerous preaching places across the lake country.
simp_chinese: 索特卡莫位于凯努东南部的湖泊与林丘之间。来自萨沃拉克斯和博滕的移民最初属于奥卢湖教区，需前往帕尔塔涅米礼拜。至1630年，这里已有布道所与牧师的记载，1647年成为独立教区。湖区各处的众多布道地点服务着散居的农庄。

english: Sotuta was a Maya lordship in the interior of Yucatán, ruled by the Cocom lineage after the fall of Mayapán. Its ruler Nachi Cocom resisted Spanish advances during the conquest of the peninsula. Spanish forces gained control of the region in the 1540s, but resistance continued: Sotuta was among the eastern Maya territories that rose together in 1546 in an effort to preserve their independence.
simp_chinese: 索图塔是尤卡坦内陆的一处玛雅领地，玛雅潘陷落后由科科姆家族统治。半岛征服期间，统治者纳奇·科科姆抵抗西班牙人的推进。西班牙军队于1540年代控制该地区，但抵抗仍在继续：1546年索图塔与东部其他玛雅领地共同起义，试图维护独立。

english: Sougb is a Papuan language of the eastern Bird’s Head Peninsula, in the forested mountain country near the Arfak range. Its communities live inland from the shores of Cenderawasih and Bintuni bays. Sougb belongs to the East Bird’s Head group, alongside Meyah and Moskona, although the languages differ considerably in vocabulary.
simp_chinese: 索格布语是鸟头半岛东部的一种巴布亚语言，分布在阿尔法克山脉附近森林覆盖的山区。社群居住在极乐鸟湾与宾图尼湾海岸的内陆。索格布语与梅亚语、莫斯科纳语同属东鸟头半岛语言组，尽管彼此词汇差异很大。

sources.title: holton and klamer 2017 in b palmer  ed  the lgs and linguistics of the new guinea area.pdf

english: Souk el Arba lies on the Medjerda in northwestern Tunisia, amid the fertile fields of the river valley. Nearby stood Bulla Regia, an ancient city with richly decorated houses, some built partly underground. The valley has long supported agriculture, and the name Souk el Arba recalls a weekly market. River, fields and routes through the valley connect the surrounding hills with the country toward Tunis.
simp_chinese: 苏克阿尔巴位于突尼斯西北部迈杰尔达河畔，四周是河谷肥沃的田地。附近曾有古城布拉雷吉亚，其装饰华丽的住宅有些部分建在地下。河谷长期供养着农业，而苏克阿尔巴之名让人想起一处每周举行的市场。河流、田地与河谷道路将周围山丘和通往突尼斯城的地区相连。

english: Sōma lies in the low country of northern Shimōsa, close to the waterways of the Tone basin. In the Edo period, works to divert the Tone eastward helped connect the river with the Edogawa and the sea near Chōshi. Boats carrying goods between Edo, northern Kantō and the northeast passed through this wider network. Reclamation and flood control also changed the neighbouring lowlands, bringing new fields into cultivation.
simp_chinese: 相马位于下总北部低地，靠近利根川水系。江户时代，利根川东迁工程使河流与江户川及銚子附近海域相连。船只利用这一水网，在江户、关东北部和东北地区之间运输货物。围垦与治水也改变了周边低地，开辟出新的耕地。
